name: qa-l10-mega-arrival
note: E32-AC10 (L10-S3): 'It is always coming.' The courier stands still behind a container stack in the frame; the Mega Alpha starts 70 m away in a non-resident area (the L9-S4 seam: coarse 2 Hz route advance, no mesh needed), enters the resident box at x = -35, steers in on the nav grid with no line of sight and arrives after ~18 s; inside 12 m the shared Alpha brain takes over (contact and the E07 Alpha specials; Mega move tuning is L10-S4). Look for: it walks into frame (no pop-in on screen), rounds the stack, feet planted, ~2x Alpha scale next to the courier. metrics.megaAlpha.modes shows coarse, detailed and close.
